summary: Max Verstappen hunts his fourth consecutive victory as McLaren closes the constructors' championship gap with a surge in pace and reliability. Ferrari's Carlos Sainz battles to capitalize on street-circuit expertise while Oscar Piastri seeks to translate recent form into podium finishes on Baku's unforgiving layout. A dominant performance could shift the constructors' battle decisively, with McLaren needing a strong showing to maintain championship momentum heading into the final sprint.
